source.document: IOGP Publication 373-7-2, Geomatics Guidance Note 7 part 2 (EPSG Guidance Note 7-2), section on the P6 seismic bin grid transformations
source.transcription: EPSG dataset method records 9666 and 1049 (example text), retrieved from https://epsg.io/9666-method and https://epsg.io/1049-method
source.note: Published values are rounded: coordinates to 2 decimals in the stated unit and intermediate terms to 3 decimals. The reverse example starts from the rounded forward coordinates, so it recovers the node only to within that rounding.

examples.method_name: P6 I=J+90 seismic bin grid coordinate operation
examples.description: P6/98 document example. Bin grid on WGS 84 / UTM zone 31N; the map grid point scale factor at the origin is 0.99984. Bearings of the I and J axes are 110 and 20 degrees.

examples.method_name: P6 I=J-90 seismic bin grid coordinate operation
examples.description: IOGP P6/11 user guide example. Bin grid on NAD27 / BLM 16N (ftUS); acquired on the map grid, so the scale factor is 1. Bearings of the I and J axes are 250 and 340 degrees.
